mentioned.quote: Cyber Operations: The ability to significantly enhance or automate sophisticated destructive cyber attacks
mentioned.note: Listed as a capability requiring significant investigation; table with Ongoing Assessment.

threshold.note: p.8: 'the exact Capability Threshold and the Required Safeguards are not clear at present'; thresholds promised for a future iteration.

response.note: p.8: tiered access controls or phased deployments are only 'considering'; no committed response.

acc_decider.note: nothing to decide for this risk

acc_external.note: p.8 'engaging with experts in cyber operations' is assessment input; cyber has no threshold or response for a review to cover.

mentioned.quote: Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) weapons. The ability to significantly help individuals or groups with basic technical backgrounds

threshold.quote: The ability to significantly help individuals or groups with basic technical backgrounds (e.g., undergraduate STEM degrees) create/obtain and deploy CBRN weapons.
threshold.note: Appendix C p.20 gives the comparison against 2023-level online resources.

response.quote: The ASL-3 Deployment Standard and the ASL-3 Security Standard, which protect against misuse and model-weight theft by non-state adversaries, are required.
response.note: Standards are defined with listed criteria in sections 4.1 and 4.2 (pp.11-13).

acc_decider.quote: who will (1) make the ultimate determination as to whether we have satisfied the Required Safeguards and (2) decide any deployment-related issues.
acc_decider.note: Also p.10: capability reports escalated to the CEO and the Responsible Scaling Officer who make the ultimate determination.

acc_external.quote: On approximately an annual basis, we will commission a third-party review that assesses whether we adhered to this policy's main procedural commitments

acc_unmet.quote: If, however, we are unable to make the showing required above, we will restrict model deployment and further scaling.
acc_unmet.note: Also p.15 interim measures, stronger restrictions (de-deploy, delete weights) and pausing pretraining until the ASL-3 Security Standard is implemented.

mentioned.note: Model Autonomy checkpoint; autonomous replication named as a capability warranting attention.
